7ff37e13ad83478bb6d57e8aaf479da1eacc062d.QuestDescription: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.$B$BThe pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
